name: Clockwork Coral Reef
description: An underwater reef built entirely from brass gears, copper pipes, and bronze mechanisms, where mechanical fish swim through kelp made of copper wire and anemones bloom from pressure gauges.
prompt: Underwater mechanical reef built from brass gears, copper piping, bronze valves and pressure gauges, mechanical fish with gear teeth and spring tails swim through kelp forests of twisted copper wire, anemones blooming from vintage pressure gauges with glowing dials, coral formations made of interconnected cogs and pistons, shafts of sunlight pierce the water illuminating floating brass particles, steampunk aesthetic, photorealistic rendering, volumetric lighting, 8k, wide angle underwater perspective
caption:
Life finds a way — even in brass and bronze. ⚙️🐠

A reef that ticks with the heartbeat of the deep.
